title: Kim Kardashian’s former mansion, where Kris Humphries proposed, listed for $8.5 million after makeover
summary_full: Kim Kardashian’s former Beverly Hills mansion, where Kris Humphries proposed to her on camera in 2011, is heading to the market for nearly $8.5 million after an extensive makeover. Kim bought the property for $3.4 million in 2010 and sold it for $3.6 million in 2013. The five-bedroom estate now boasts luxurious modern interiors.
